correctness.rationale: A multinomial CLT plus fourth-moment uniform integrability establishes the N^{-1} limiting variance. The finite covariance is v=a(5-9a), c=a(9a-4), and the standard folded-normal absolute-product identity gives V exactly. Under r=(9a-4)/(5-9a), its derivative has numerator H and H double prime equals (1+r)(15+4r-10r^2)/(1-r^2)^{3/2}, strictly positive on (-4/5,1). Exact signs H(-4/5)>0,H(0)<0,H(1)>0 force exactly two zeros and +,-,+ derivative signs; the trial a=1/4 beats the boundary values. The accompanying standard-library checker passed 296 deterministic checks, including exact multinomial finite-N sums; it does not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The trinomial reflection-symmetric family is the smallest nontrivial matched-reference roughness model with two dependent adjacent increments. Determining its globally worst null Gaussian-scale variance is a natural calibration quantity. The exact optimizer and a previously unrecognized second turning point offer a complete structural classification, with the strict-convex derivative reduction valid for every admissible parameter—not a selected numeric case or a routine substitution. No stronger full-simplex or finite-sample significance is asserted.
